test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

I shall certainly write to you when __I shall reach__ Bengaluru.
solution:
The correct answer is **"I reach"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of **"I shall reach" **is incorrect Instead of this we need to use **"I reach"**
 
• In the given sentence, the conjunction of "when" is used. It is a conjunction used for time.
 
• There are two clauses and in the first clause we have used the future tense hence, in the subordinate clause we need to use "the present tense"

**So the correct sentence is-** *I shall certainly write to you** when I reach** Bengaluru.*
